page.title: 情報は、頭と心を旅する

analysis.summaryJa: tell・ask・know・think・believeは、情報が人から人へ渡り、要求され、頭に蓄えられ、検討され、さらに深い確信になる流れとして整理できる。tellは相手へ情報・指示を渡し、askは質問・依頼として情報や助けを求める。knowは答えや事実が頭の中にある状態、thinkは頭を動かして意見・判断を作ること、believeは真実性や価値を深く受け入れることを表す。目的語・前置詞・補文の違いを使って自然な語を選ぶ。
grammarPoints: tell + 人 + 内容 / to不定詞で、特定の相手へ情報や指示を渡す
ask + 人 + 質問、ask + 人 + for + 名詞、ask + 人 + to不定詞で、情報・物・行動を求める
know + 名詞/that節/疑問詞節で、既知の事実・答えが頭の中にある状態を表す
think + that節で意見・判断、think aboutは検討、think ofは印象・思いつきなどを表す
believe + 名詞/that節は真実性への確信、believe in + 名詞は存在・価値・能力への深い信頼を表す
thinkとbelieveはどちらも意見を表せるが、believeのほうが確信・信念に焦点が強い
visualEvidence: tellのhandoffが情報を相手へ渡す方向を示す
askのrequest gateが情報・助けを外へ求める動きを示す
knowのmemory vaultが既知情報の保持、thinkのgearsが検討、believeのheart-rootが深い確信を示す
think＝考え・判断、believe＝深い確信という比較タグ
think ofのミニ確認が対象への印象を尋ねる用法を示す
commonTraps: tell to 人とし、tellが人を直接目的語に取ることを忘れる
ask for 人 to doのように、ask + 人 + to不定詞とask + 人 + for + 名詞を混同する
knowを進行形にして既知状態を表そうとする
think ofとthink aboutを機械的に同じと考え、印象・検討の焦点を見落とす
believe inとbelieve thatの形を混同する
単なる一時的な判断にbelieveを使うか、強い信念にthinkを使うかで文脈の確信度を見落とす

questions.prompt: Please ------- the visitor that the west elevator is temporarily out of service.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: ask
choices.C: know
choices.D: think

questions.translationJa: 来訪者に西側エレベーターが一時停止していると伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 情報の受け手the visitorを直接目的語に取るtellが適切です。

questions.prompt: Could you ------- the hotel for a late check-out before our afternoon meeting?

choices.A: tell
choices.B: ask
choices.C: know
choices.D: believe

questions.translationJa: 午後の会議前に、ホテルへレイトチェックアウトを依頼してもらえますか。
questions.explanationJa: 相手へサービスを求める依頼なのでaskが適切です。

questions.prompt: Do you ------- where the replacement batteries are stored?

choices.A: tell
choices.B: ask
choices.C: know
choices.D: believe

questions.translationJa: 交換用バッテリーがどこに保管されているか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 答えが頭の中にあるかを尋ねるためknow + 疑問詞節を使います。

questions.prompt: I ------- the revised schedule will reduce waiting time at the service counter.

choices.A: ask
choices.B: tell
choices.C: know
choices.D: think

questions.translationJa: 改訂された予定によりサービス窓口の待ち時間が減ると思います。
questions.explanationJa: 話者の判断・意見を表すのでthink + that省略の節が自然です。

questions.prompt: The project team strongly ------- in the value of testing the new system with actual users.

choices.A: believes
choices.B: thinks
choices.C: asks
choices.D: tells

questions.translationJa: プロジェクトチームは、実際の利用者で新システムを試す価値を強く信じています。
questions.explanationJa: 価値への深い信頼はbelieve in + 名詞で表します。

questions.prompt: The supervisor ------- the new employee to complete the safety course before entering the laboratory.

choices.A: said
choices.B: told
choices.C: asked for
choices.D: knew

questions.translationJa: 監督者は新人に、研究室へ入る前に安全講習を修了するよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: tell + 人 + to不定詞で相手へ指示を渡します。

questions.prompt: Ms. Brown ------- the supplier for a written estimate rather than a verbal price.

choices.A: told
choices.B: knew
choices.C: asked
choices.D: believed

questions.translationJa: ブラウンさんは仕入先に、口頭価格ではなく書面の見積もりを求めました。
questions.explanationJa: ask + 人 + for + 名詞で物・情報を求めます。

questions.prompt: We do not yet ------- whether the conference room will be available after 5 p.m.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: think about
choices.C: ask
choices.D: know

questions.translationJa: 会議室が午後5時以降利用できるか、まだ分かっていません。
questions.explanationJa: 既知かどうかをwhether節で示すのでknowが適切です。

questions.prompt: Before choosing a carrier, we need to ------- carefully about delivery speed, insurance, and weekend service.

choices.A: think
choices.B: know
choices.C: tell
choices.D: believe in

questions.translationJa: 運送会社を選ぶ前に、配送速度、保険、週末サービスについて慎重に考える必要があります。
questions.explanationJa: 複数要素を検討するのでthink aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: Although the pilot program is small, the director ------- that its results can guide the national rollout.

choices.A: asks
choices.B: believes
choices.C: tells
choices.D: knows whether

questions.translationJa: 試験運用は小規模ですが、取締役はその結果が全国展開の指針になると確信しています。
questions.explanationJa: まだ確定事実ではなく、強い見解・確信なのでbelieves thatが適切です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about informing a guest.

choices.A: Please tell to the guest that breakfast starts at seven.
choices.B: Please say the guest that breakfast starts at seven.
choices.C: Please tell the guest that breakfast starts at seven.
choices.D: Please ask the guest that breakfast starts at seven.

questions.translationJa: 来客に朝食は7時に始まると伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: tellは情報の受け手the guestを直接目的語に取ります。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about requesting help.

choices.A: I asked the receptionist for help with my luggage.
choices.B: I asked for the receptionist help with my luggage.
choices.C: I told the receptionist for help with my luggage.
choices.D: I knew the receptionist for help with my luggage.

questions.translationJa: 私は受付担当者に荷物について助けを求めました。
questions.explanationJa: ask + 人 + for + 名詞が正しい依頼の形です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about factual knowledge.

choices.A: We are knowing that the last shuttle leaves at 10:30 p.m.
choices.B: We know that the last shuttle leaves at 10:30 p.m.
choices.C: We know about that the last shuttle leaves at 10:30 p.m.
choices.D: We ask that the last shuttle leaves at 10:30 p.m. as a fact.

questions.translationJa: 最終シャトルが午後10時30分に出ることを知っています。
questions.explanationJa: knowは状態動詞で、既知の事実をknow that節で表します。通常進行形にはしません。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about considering a proposal.

choices.A: The committee is knowing about extending the service hours.
choices.B: The committee is telling about extending the service hours.
choices.C: The committee is believing about extending the service hours.
choices.D: The committee is thinking about extending the service hours.

questions.translationJa: 委員会はサービス時間の延長を検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: 検討中の思考はthink about + -ingで表せます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about confidence in a team.

choices.A: The manager believes her team's ability in to solve the problem.
choices.B: The manager thinks in her team's ability to solve the problem.
choices.C: The manager believes in her team's ability to solve the problem.
choices.D: The manager knows in her team's ability to solve the problem.

questions.translationJa: 管理者はチームが問題を解決する能力を信頼しています。
questions.explanationJa: 能力・価値への信頼はbelieve in + 名詞です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about asking someone to perform an action.

choices.A: We asked the technician to check the projector again.
choices.B: We asked to the technician check the projector again.
choices.C: We asked the technician for check the projector again.
choices.D: We told for the technician to check the projector again.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは技術者にプロジェクターをもう一度確認するよう依頼しました。
questions.explanationJa: ask + 人 + to不定詞で相手に行動を依頼します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about knowing an answer.

choices.A: Do you know that which platform the airport train uses?
choices.B: Do you know which platform the airport train uses?
choices.C: Are you knowing which platform the airport train uses?
choices.D: Do you tell which platform the airport train uses without an object?

questions.translationJa: 空港行き列車がどのホームを使うか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: know + 疑問詞節では平叙文語順which platform the train usesを使います。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about asking for an opinion.

choices.A: What do you know of the new reception layout as an opinion?
choices.B: What do you tell of the new reception layout?
choices.C: What are you thinking the new reception layout of?
choices.D: What do you think of the new reception layout?

questions.translationJa: 新しい受付レイアウトをどう思いますか。
questions.explanationJa: 対象への印象・評価を尋ねる定型表現はWhat do you think of ...?です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about a strong conviction.

choices.A: I am believing that the revised process will prevent most booking errors.
choices.B: I believe in that the revised process will prevent most booking errors.
choices.C: I believe that the revised process will prevent most booking errors.
choices.D: I ask that the revised process will prevent most booking errors as my conviction.

questions.translationJa: 改訂された手順で大半の予約ミスを防げると私は確信しています。
questions.explanationJa: 内容の真実性への確信はbelieve that節で表します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence about instructing a group.

choices.A: The guide told to us remain behind the yellow line.
choices.B: The guide told us to remain behind the yellow line.
choices.C: The guide said us to remain behind the yellow line.
choices.D: The guide asked for us remain behind the yellow line.

questions.translationJa: 案内係は私たちに黄色い線の後ろにいるよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: tell + 人 + to不定詞が指示の正しい構文です。

questions.prompt: The clerk informed me that the item was back in stock. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The clerk said me that the item was back in stock.
choices.B: The clerk told to me that the item was back in stock.
choices.C: The clerk asked me that the item was back in stock.
choices.D: The clerk told me that the item was back in stock.

questions.translationJa: 店員は私に、その商品が再入荷したと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: inform + 人はtell + 人 + 内容で自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: We requested a copy of the receipt from the hotel. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: We told the hotel for a copy of the receipt.
choices.B: We asked for the hotel a copy of the receipt.
choices.C: We asked the hotel for a copy of the receipt.
choices.D: We knew the hotel for a copy of the receipt.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはホテルに領収書のコピーを求めました。
questions.explanationJa: request A from Bはask B for Aで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: I am aware of the reason the service was delayed. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: I know why the service was delayed.
choices.B: I think why the service was delayed as a question.
choices.C: I ask why the service was delayed because I already know.
choices.D: I believe in why the service was delayed.

questions.translationJa: サービスが遅れた理由を私は知っています。
questions.explanationJa: 既知の理由を表すaware ofはknow whyで自然に言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The team is considering moving the event indoors. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The team is knowing about moving the event indoors.
choices.B: The team is thinking about moving the event indoors.
choices.C: The team is believing in moving the event indoors as a fact.
choices.D: The team is telling about moving the event indoors.

questions.translationJa: チームはイベントを屋内へ移すことを検討しています。
questions.explanationJa: considerはthink about + -ingで検討の意味を表せます。

questions.prompt: The director has confidence in the new service model. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The director thinks in the new service model.
choices.B: The director knows in the new service model.
choices.C: The director asks in the new service model.
choices.D: The director believes in the new service model.

questions.translationJa: 取締役は新しいサービスモデルを信頼しています。
questions.explanationJa: have confidence inはbelieve inで価値への信頼を表せます。

questions.prompt: The supervisor requested that I update the contact list. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The supervisor asked to me to update the contact list.
choices.B: The supervisor asked me for update the contact list.
choices.C: The supervisor asked me to update the contact list.
choices.D: The supervisor told for me to update the contact list.

questions.translationJa: 監督者は私に連絡先一覧を更新するよう依頼しました。
questions.explanationJa: request that someone doはask + 人 + to不定詞で言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: We are certain of the train's departure time. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: We know what time the train departs.
choices.B: We think what time the train departs because we are uncertain.
choices.C: We ask what time the train departs because we already know.
choices.D: We believe in what time the train departs.

questions.translationJa: 私たちは列車の出発時刻を知っています。
questions.explanationJa: 確定した情報が頭にあるのでknow + 疑問詞節が同義です。

questions.prompt: Tell me your impression of the redesigned lobby. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: Tell me what you know of the redesigned lobby as a fact only.
choices.B: Tell me what you think of the redesigned lobby.
choices.C: Ask me what I think of the redesigned lobby.
choices.D: Believe me what you think of the redesigned lobby.

questions.translationJa: 改装されたロビーをどう思うか教えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 対象への印象はwhat you think of ...で表せます。

questions.prompt: She is convinced that the new route will save time. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: She asks that the new route will save time.
choices.B: She knows whether the new route will save time but has no view.
choices.C: She thinks in the new route will save time.
choices.D: She believes that the new route will save time.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は新しい経路で時間を節約できると確信しています。
questions.explanationJa: be convinced thatは強い確信を表すbelieve thatで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: The trainer instructed the participants to switch off their phones. Choose the sentence with the same meaning.

choices.A: The trainer said the participants to switch off their phones.
choices.B: The trainer told to the participants switch off their phones.
choices.C: The trainer told the participants to switch off their phones.
choices.D: The trainer asked for the participants switch off their phones.

questions.translationJa: 講師は参加者に携帯電話の電源を切るよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: instruct + 人 + to doはtell + 人 + to doで言い換えられます。

questions.prompt: A guest is waiting for the airport shuttle. Please ------- him that it will arrive in about ten minutes.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: ask
choices.C: think
choices.D: know

questions.translationJa: 来客が空港シャトルを待っています。約10分で到着すると彼に伝えてください。
questions.explanationJa: 受け手himへ具体的な情報を渡すのでtellが適切です。

questions.prompt: We need a larger room for Friday's seminar. I'll ------- the conference center whether Room C is available.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: know
choices.C: believe
choices.D: ask

questions.translationJa: 金曜日のセミナーにはもっと大きな部屋が必要です。会議施設にC室が空いているか尋ねます。
questions.explanationJa: 未知の情報を相手に求めるのでask whetherが自然です。

questions.prompt: The invoice number is already in our database. I ------- exactly which order the customer is referring to.

choices.A: ask
choices.B: know
choices.C: tell
choices.D: think

questions.translationJa: 請求書番号はすでにデータベースにあります。顧客がどの注文を指しているか正確に分かります。
questions.explanationJa: 答えが既知の情報として頭にあるのでknowを使います。

questions.prompt: The proposal is less expensive, but implementation would take longer. I ------- we should compare the total cost over three years before deciding.

choices.A: tell
choices.B: ask
choices.C: think
choices.D: know

questions.translationJa: 提案は安価ですが導入には時間がかかります。決定前に3年間の総費用を比較すべきだと思います。
questions.explanationJa: 検討から生まれた話者の判断・提案なのでthinkが適切です。

questions.prompt: The company has invested in this community for twenty years. Local partners ------- in its long-term commitment.

choices.A: believe
choices.B: ask
choices.C: tell
choices.D: know whether

questions.translationJa: 会社はこの地域に20年間投資してきました。地域の提携先はその長期的な姿勢を信頼しています。
questions.explanationJa: 価値・姿勢への深い信頼なのでbelieve inを使います。

questions.prompt: The customer did not understand the installation fee. I ------- her to send me a photo of the invoice so I could explain it accurately.

choices.A: told for
choices.B: knew
choices.C: believed
choices.D: asked

questions.translationJa: 顧客は設置料金を理解していませんでした。正確に説明できるよう、請求書の写真を送ってもらうよう依頼しました。
questions.explanationJa: 相手herへ行動を依頼するのでasked + O + to doです。

questions.prompt: Before we reserve the venue, do you ------- how many parking spaces are available for guests?

choices.A: tell
choices.B: know
choices.C: believe in
choices.D: ask for

questions.translationJa: 会場を予約する前に、来客用駐車スペースが何台分あるか知っていますか。
questions.explanationJa: 既知の数量情報を尋ねるknow how manyが適切です。

questions.prompt: The first estimate covers equipment only. We should ------- about staffing and transportation costs as well before approving the budget.

choices.A: know
choices.B: tell
choices.C: think
choices.D: believe in

questions.translationJa: 最初の見積もりは設備費だけです。予算承認前に人員費と輸送費についても考えるべきです。
questions.explanationJa: 追加要素を検討するのでthink aboutが自然です。

questions.prompt: When I asked Ms. Chen for her opinion, she said she ------- the new booking system would be easier for customers to use.

choices.A: believed
choices.B: asked
choices.C: told
choices.D: knew whether

questions.translationJa: チェンさんに意見を尋ねると、新しい予約システムは顧客にとって使いやすくなると思うと答えました。
questions.explanationJa: 単なる既知事実ではなく、ある程度確信を伴う見解なのでbelieved thatが適切です。

questions.prompt: The emergency procedure is mandatory, not optional. The supervisor ------- every contractor to report to the assembly point if the alarm sounds.

choices.A: asked for
choices.B: thought
choices.C: believed in
choices.D: told

questions.translationJa: 緊急手順は任意ではなく必須です。監督者は全請負業者に、警報が鳴ったら集合地点へ行くよう指示しました。
questions.explanationJa: 必須の指示を特定の相手へ渡すのでtold + O + to doが適切です。
